description.value: Hannam Supermarket is Western Canada's leading Korean grocery chain, with this Metrotown location being its newest branch, opened in 2025. The store carries over 11,000 Korean food products and household items, serving both the Korean-Canadian community and anyone seeking authentic Asian ingredients. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a full-scale supermarket with fresh produce, pantry staples, and Korean specialty goods.
